channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: India tour of Australia: Pratika Rawal returns for ODI series
item.description: Pratika Rawal had picked up an injury during India's victorious 2025 ICC Women's ODI World Cup campaign.

item.title: Players’ pleas ignored as AFC freezes Women’s Asian Cup 2026 prize money at $1.8 Million
item.description: A signed letter from seven nations calls for equal pay and conditions, but AFC maintains an unchanged prize pool for the Australia tournament.

item.title: Explained: How to qualify for 2028 LA Olympics in weightlifting?
item.description: A total of 120 weightlifters will compete in 12 weight categories at the 2028 LA Olympics.

item.title: Delhi Open 2026: Sumit Nagal advances to second round
item.description: Sumit Nagal is aiming to become only the second Indian to win the Delhi Open men's singles title.

item.title: AFC Women's Asian Cup: India to play friendly games against two Australian clubs
item.description: Blue Tigresses will compete against Perth RedStar FC and Perth Azzurri as pre-tournament warm-up matches.

item.title: “Our goal is FIFA World Cup”: Grace Dangmei ahead of the AFC Women’s Asian Cup 2026
item.description: India forward Grace Dangmei speaks about the team’s World Cup dream and the challenge of Japan, Vietnam and Chinese Taipei at the Asian Cup in Australia.

item.title: FIH Pro League: 11 losses in 12 matches puts Indian men's team under scanner
item.description: Indian men's hockey team's dismal performance in the Rourkela leg points at the cracks within the set up.

item.title: TraceX Guard AI Mobile Security App Launched to Combat Rising Mobile Cyber Threats in India
item.description: With smartphone usage rapidly increasing across India, TraceX Labs has launched TraceX Guard, an AI-powered mobile security application.
